matches.title: Bhayangkara FC vs Isenmulang FC
matches.description: Watch Bhayangkara FC vs Isenmulang FC highlights and goals from Liga 1 - Indonesia on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 20, 2026. The stage was set for a compelling Liga 1 encounter as Bhayangkara FC hosted Isenmulang FC . Supporters from both sides gathered in anticipation of a match that promised to test the tactical discipline and clinical edge of two competitive squads. Breakthrough in the Second Half On September 20, 2026 , the match unfolded with a cautious opening period. While the first half saw both teams creating half-chances, defensive organizations remained on top, keeping the scoreline level as the players headed into the break. The deadlock, however, was not destined to last long into the second half . In the 56th minute, the home side found the opening they were looking for. Allano displayed great composure to strike a decisive goal , giving Bhayangkara FC a 1-0 lead. The momentum shifted instantly, forcing Isenmulang FC to abandon their conservative approach in search of a way back into the game, which led to a more expansive and energetic display of football . Late Drama Seals the Result As the clock ticked toward full-time, the pressure from Isenmulang FC intensified, but they struggled to find a way past a resolute backline. Bhayangkara FC remained patient, waiting for the right moment to catch their opponents on the break as they pushed higher up the pitch. The defining moment of the match arrived deep into stoppage time. In the 95th minute (90+5), T. M. Ichsan capitalized on a late opportunity to double the lead. His clinical finish effectively ended the contest, securing a 2-0 victory for Bhayangkara FC in a sports spectacle that rewarded their persistence and clinical finishing.
